part.text:
Implemented `--ignored-suffix` support:

- Added repeatable `--ignored-suffix` CLI option, so it also works from `~/.config/bat/config`.
- Moved ignored-suffix handling into `SyntaxMapping`, preserving built-in backup/template suffixes and adding user-defined ones.
- Updated syntax detection to use configured ignored suffixes.

Validated:
- `ignored_suffix_arg` integration test passes.
- Both new `ignored_suffixes` unit tests pass.
- All 39 library tests pass.

The full integration suite reaches an unrelated pre-existing abort in `no_args_doesnt_break` (`IO Safety violation: owned file descriptor already closed`).
